messages.text: Does the harlo labs os work on the nexus S-1

I sent the customer's question about running Harlo OS on the Nexus S1 to the hardware specialist, who will answer them in the chat. I haven't replied to the customer myself.

I first tried to check harlolabs.com for whether the S1 is supported, but the site couldn't be fetched. So I don't have an answer of my own, and none was given.
